pages.text: Recognize the Signs and Symptoms of Carbon Monoxide (CO) Poisoning If you feel you may have any signs or symptoms OR your CO alarm or CO detector sounds, STEP 1: Get yourself and others outdoors to an area with clean air immediately. STEP 2: CALL 911! STEP 3: Do NOT drive a motor vehicle. STEP 4: Stay away from the area until it is determined to be safe.
